text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the plaza... I spotted Narita Taishin
listening to music beside a bench.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was a song like this on the rankings?
—A new track?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so this is what's in right now...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Oh, it's you.
...Need something?
choice_data_list: What genres do you listen to?
What genres do you listen to?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Half-assed. Just mindlessly blasting whatever's trending.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's not like I have a favorite or anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Who cares what song it is? They're all the same.
As long as there's something playing in the background.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Different genres take turns in rotation.
It gets boring if it's always the same.
choice_data_list: Would you be fine with there being no music at all?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"That's... not it.
It's better if something is playing. But..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That 'something' could be anything at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Afterwards, we chatted about music for a while
as we walked.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, music is just sound.
Just a way to kill time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like something like this is gonna shake my feelings.
I'm not a kid, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're daydreaming way too much.
There's no way that'd happen...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you've really got something that can move me,
let me hear it. Like, what kind of song is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to music that might resonate
with the notoriously prickly Narita Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Live R&B... at a live house, you mean?
I've never heard that kind of music before, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Aren't live music venues always packed?
I really hate crowded places.
choice_data_list: There are quiet places too, you know.
There are quiet places too, so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then take me with you.
Just saying, if I don't like it, I'm heading back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, we arrived at a live music venue playing the latest R&B.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Taishin swayed her body
to the unfamiliar, fierce yet gentle UK beat."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Such a strange feeling...
It's loud, yet not grating on my ears at all..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So it exists. Music that I never knew about.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Every single sound felt muffled,
like it was being thrust up from the soles of my feet.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Heeeeeeey!!!!!
TAISHIIIIIIIN!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geh...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin! You came too, Taishin!?
To that concert just nooowww!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was invited too!!!!!
But I have no clue what's going on at all!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, you wouldn't understand.
Not someone like you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Still, though!! Isn't it just so great!! All that thumping and booming, and that floating vibe—!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
This crazy "WOOOOOAAAAHHH!?" kind of feeling,
even you can understand it, right, Taishin!!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. I get it.
But you don't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Well Trainer,
I'm heading home now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Maybe... I'm glad I came today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: See ya.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Waaait, Taishin!
Let's have a passionate talk about muuuusiiic!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up! Your voice is just loud!
It's not like that music from earlier at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin walks away briskly.
She seemed to have gained a bit of energy from the unfamiliar beat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Some kind of subculture thing?
I don't really get it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, weren't they doing some kind
of event like that at the planetarium right now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Something like, "Listen to pop music
while looking down at Earth from outer space."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose we could take a peek.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, the two of us came to the planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They're... kind of mysterious lyrics, aren't they?
Bubbles, fleeting moments, dust and wisdom...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
All these worries and doubts are just ripples in the water...
I wonder if that's all we really are...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the existential celestial music show came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I can't really put it into words, but how should I say it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, you came too, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide? Was Hayahide always
into this kind of thing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, I merely came here as part of my astronomical research,
and it just happened to coincide with this event.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Still, logically speaking,
those lyrics were a bit inconsistent."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The largest star in the universe. Considering the distance from there to Earth,
there's no way our feelings could reach in an instant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide.
Couldn't you think about it a bit more casually?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"It really just depends on how you look at it.
Maybe our way of thinking is what's off."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin... You're not quite yourself today.
For someone so sensitive, you seem so unfazed."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Did you change your creed or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Not really.
Well, let's see... maybe it's..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—Just a whim.
Nothing more than that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Immersing herself in the world of modern pop music,
Narita Taishin seems to have gained a new perspective on the world.
